subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The coach was __optimistic__ that Ronald will play the quarter final.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"optimistic"** means having a hopeful and positive outlook about the future. (आशावादी)

 
 
• **Example: **The coach was **optimistic** that his team would win the championship.
 
 
 
• **"Doubtful" **refers to feeling uncertain or lacking conviction. (संदेहपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **She was **doubtful **about the success of the new project.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'optimistic' **is **'doubtful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tasteful **(स्वादिष्ट): Showing good aesthetic judgment or appropriate behavior.

 
 
• **Example:** The artist's work was both **tasteful** and innovative.
 
 
 
• **Helpful **(सहायक): Providing assistance or being useful.
 
 
• **Example: **The staff was very **helpful** in guiding us through the museum.
 
 
 
• **Cheerful** (प्रसन्न): Noticeably happy and optimistic.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the bad news, she remained** cheerful.**
 
 

3c:Tb2d,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**</
